items.heading: Beef Noodle Soup
details: Key ingredients: beef shank, noodles, star anise, soy sauce
Simmer beef shank with star anise, soy sauce and aromatics for hours.
Cook thick wheat noodles separately until tender.
Ladle the rich braised broth and beef over the noodles.
Top with pickled greens and scallion before serving.

items.heading: Oyster Omelette
details: Key ingredients: oysters, egg, sweet potato starch, greens
Fry fresh oysters briefly on a hot griddle.
Pour a starch and egg batter over the oysters.
Add leafy greens and cook until the edges turn crisp and lacy.
Drizzle with a sweet-savory sauce before serving.
